name: FoxAlien Reisler 2
tagline: FoxAlien's 20W open-frame: CNC brand crossing into lasers
tldr: FoxAlien brings CNC-adjacent build quality to a 20W diode platform. Solid alternative to Ortur/Sculpfun for makers who already trust the FoxAlien ecosystem from CNC routers.
mainObjective: 20W diode engraving and light cutting for FoxAlien ecosystem users

Software on the profile: trial your workflow on scrap before production
cons: Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone
